title: PIA’s Empowerment Pillar Focuses on Giving Women Sustainable Livelihood Skills
imageAlt: PIA’s Empowerment Pillar Focuses on Giving Women Sustainable Livelihood Skills
summary: Focusing on practical skills and sustainable enterprise, Dr. Patience Ishaku Abbo’s empowerment pillar continues to expand agricultural processing and trade opportunities for women collectives.
body:
Focusing on practical skills and sustainable enterprise, Dr. Patience Ishaku Abbo’s empowerment pillar continues to expand agricultural processing and trade opportunities for women collectives.

Beneficiaries receive both equipment and ongoing mentorship to scale their local businesses and support their families.
